scope: First scout candidate as the family's representative sample. It is reviewed on its own before the medic or any family delivery; family continuity and destination display are deferred to the family.characters row.

contract.intent: Owner-confirmed: 32 by 32 canvas, side view, binary transparency, nearest-neighbor display, the continuous dark outline of reference.png and the teal and cream palette named by role. Specialist proposal scoped to this sample: the exact three opaque colours measured in reference.png (#25354A outline, #56B5BC teal, #F4DDA2 cream) are the only opaque colours, giving flat unshaded fill with no intermediate edge colours.

criteria.check: The scout file is a single frame measuring exactly 32 by 32 pixels.
Every pixel alpha value in the scout file is exactly 0 or 255.
Every opaque pixel in the scout file is one of the three proposed sample colours #25354A, #56B5BC or #F4DDA2.
criteria.basis: Specialist proposal for the first sample, derived from the colours measured in reference.png; the owner named the palette by role only.
criteria.scope: This sample candidate; not yet a family rule

sources.locator: Observations: measured reference colours and their proposal status

criteria.check: Viewed at native scale and at an integer enlargement on a light and a dark background, the scout silhouette is bounded by a continuous dark outline in the manner of reference.png, with no un-outlined edge runs like reference-b.png.
criteria.basis: Owner choice 1 in BRIEF.md: the dark outline of reference.png
criteria.scope: This candidate compared with both references

criteria.check: Compared beside reference.png at native scale and at an integer enlargement, the scout reads as the same art language: flat teal fill, cream accents, blocky cluster scale and a side view.
criteria.basis: Owner choices 1, 3 and 5 in BRIEF.md and the role of reference.png as the style reference

criteria.check: At native scale and at an integer enlargement the figure reads as a scout in side view: a light, mobile character whose chosen scouting landmarks stay separable from the body silhouette.
criteria.basis: The assignment names a scout; the specific landmarks (peaked cap or hood brim, shoulder-strap satchel) are a specialist design proposal.
criteria.scope: This candidate; the landmark choice may be revised without changing the owner's brief
